note: Script library for the FA Vision add-on's side panel (extension/sidepanel.js). The panel downloads this file from the live site, so adding or editing a script here updates every add-on. lang: page (runs on the open tab from the panel), python, python-selenium, python-playwright, node-puppeteer.

scripts.title: Start here: let your own scripts control Edge
scripts.about: Starts a separate Edge window that Python, Playwright and Puppeteer scripts can control, then lists its open tabs. Log in to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X once in that window; it remembers you.
scripts.how:
1. In Command Prompt run:
   "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe" --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=C:\FAVisionRobot
2. Log in to your sites in that new window (first time only).
3. pip install selenium
4. python start_here.py
scripts.code:
# Lists the tabs open in the Edge window started with --remote-debugging-port=9222
# pip install selenium
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.edge.options import Options

opts = Options()
opts.add_experimental_option("debuggerAddress", "127.0.0.1:9222")
driver = webdriver.Edge(options=opts)

for handle in driver.window_handles:
    driver.switch_to.window(handle)
    print(driver.title, "-", driver.current_url)

print("Connected. Your scripts can now drive this window.")

scripts.title: Playwright: open a page in your Edge and take a screenshot
scripts.about: Connects Playwright to the Edge window from "Start here" and saves a full-page screenshot of your website.
scripts.code:
# pip install playwright
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

URL = "https://favisionenterprize.github.io/"

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222")
    context = browser.contexts[0]
    page = context.new_page()
    page.goto(URL, wait_until="networkidle")
    page.screenshot(path="favision_home.png", full_page=True)
    print("Saved favision_home.png")
    page.close()

scripts.title: Bulk-download images from images.txt
scripts.about: Downloads every address in images.txt (from the image-list page script) into a photos folder.
scripts.code:
# pip install requests
import os, requests

os.makedirs("photos", exist_ok=True)
urls = [u.strip() for u in open("images.txt", encoding="utf-8") if u.strip()]
for n, u in enumerate(urls, 1):
    try:
        r = requests.get(u, timeout=60)
        r.raise_for_status()
        ext = ".png" if "png" in r.headers.get("content-type", "") else ".jpg"
        with open(os.path.join("photos", f"photo_{n:03d}{ext}"), "wb") as f:
            f.write(r.content)
    except Exception as e:
        print("Skipped", u, e)
print(f"Done: {len(urls)} addresses processed into ./photos")

scripts.title: Screenshot a list of web pages
scripts.about: Opens each address in urls.txt in your Edge (from "Start here") and saves a screenshot of each, e.g. as proof that ads or listings are live.
scripts.how:
pip install playwright
Put one address per line in urls.txt
python screenshot_list.py
scripts.code:
# pip install playwright
import re
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

urls = [u.strip() for u in open("urls.txt", encoding="utf-8") if u.strip()]
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222")
    page = browser.contexts[0].new_page()
    for n, u in enumerate(urls, 1):
        page.goto(u, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
        page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        name = f"{n:02d}_" + re.sub(r"[^\w]+", "_", u)[:60] + ".png"
        page.screenshot(path=name)
        print("Saved", name)
    page.close()

scripts.title: Fill a web form once per row of a CSV
scripts.about: For your own systems: opens a form page and fills it once for each row of data.csv, asking you before each submit. Edit FIELDS to match the form.
scripts.how:
pip install selenium
Make data.csv with headers matching FIELDS
python fill_form.py
scripts.code:
# pip install selenium
import csv, time
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.edge.options import Options

FORM_URL = "https://example.com/form"     # change this
FIELDS = {                                 # CSV column -> CSS selector of the input
    "name": "input[name=name]",
    "phone": "input[name=phone]",
    "message": "textarea[name=message]",
}
SUBMIT = "button[type=submit]"

opts = Options()
opts.add_experimental_option("debuggerAddress", "127.0.0.1:9222")
driver = webdriver.Edge(options=opts)

for row in csv.DictReader(open("data.csv", encoding="utf-8")):
    driver.get(FORM_URL)
    time.sleep(2)
    for col, sel in FIELDS.items():
        box = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, sel)
        box.clear()
        box.send_keys(row.get(col, ""))
    if input(f"Submit row for {row.get('name', '')}? [y/N] ").lower() == "y":
        driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, SUBMIT).click()
        time.sleep(2)
print("Done.")
